seatLayout.coordinateMeaning: x/y are the top-left coordinates of each 4x4 Seat rectangle.
seatLayout.containmentRule: Every complete 4x4 Seat rectangle is 100% covered by its corresponding SVG Mask in vector geometry.
seatLayout.spacingRule: W letters use a 6px lattice; O uses a 5px lattice. Seat size is identical for all 8016 seats.
